description: Active shipments whose carrier ETA has slipped versus the first ETA BerthTime saw, by at least min_delay_hours, most delayed first. Use it for "what is late"; for shipments predicted to be late from the vessel position use list_shipments with eta_risk=likely_late. All arguments are optional: min_delay_hours (0-10000, default 24), limit (1-200, default 50). Returns: min_delay_hours, shipments[] {id, reference, ref_type, carrier, customer_reference, status, tracking_status, phase, pol, pod, eta, original_eta, delay_hours, predicted_eta, eta_risk, vessel, containers, booking_number, bl_number, tracked_via} (delay_hours = the slip). No paging.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

min_delay_hours.description: Minimum ETA slip vs the first ETA seen, in hours.

name: list_delayed_shipments
title: Delayed shipments
